senses.gloss: तट- + आघात तट- + आघात, m. butting at a bank or mound, Kumāras. 2, 50.

तट् तट्, i. 1 or 6, Par. To groan (ved.).
 --† i. 1. To rise; i. 10, ताटय, Par. v. r. of 1. तड्.

तट तट,
 I. m.
 1. Slope, MBh. 1, 1567.
 2. Horizon, Kathās. 26, 26.
 II. m. and f. टी, and n.
 1. A bank, MBh. 13, 1334.
 2. Often without a special signification as latter part of a comp. whose former part denotes a portion of the human body, e. g. अधर-, The lips, Gīt. 4, 23; कटि-, The hip, Indr. 2, 32; कण्ठ-, The throat, Rājat. 5, 1; जघन-, The buttocks, Bhartṛ. 1, 49; ललाट-, The forehead, Śiś. 9, 28; श्रवण-, The ear, Ṛt. 5, 13; स्तन-, The bosom, Amar. 21.
 --Comp.
तट- + स्थ तट- + स्थ, adj. indifferent, Utt. Rāmac. 156, 8.
तटाक तटा + क, cf. तट, m. and n. A pond, Rām. 2, 68, 19.

तटिनी तटिनी, i. e. तट + इन् + ई, f. A river, Rājat. 3, 339.
 --Comp.
तट्य तट्य, i. e. तट + य, adj. Dwelling on slopes, MBh. 12, 10381.
